sample_data.method: file upload and bundled default dataset
sample_data.reset_instructions: Click the 'Reset Default' button in the top navigation bar or upload the JSON fixture P08_school_results_public.json directly via the 'Upload JSON' button.

problem_solving_method: Deterministic GPA rule engine with per-student trace logs and office checking lists, built using React and TanStack Start with fully client-side evaluation (no backend).

R1.evidence: src/lib/gpaEngine.ts, src/lib/defaultDataset.json, src/routes/index.tsx (Class 9 & 10 with 80 students and hard edges: high avg fail, practical fail with passing theory, optional <= 2.0, absent)

R2.evidence: src/lib/gpaEngine.ts (evaluateStudent, evaluateCase, getGradePointAndLetter, getLetterFromGpa implementing R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13)

R3.evidence: src/routes/index.tsx Tab 3 (Per-student trace displaying raw marks, theory/practical breakdown, grade point, governing rule applied, step-by-step GPA formula resolution, and highlighted failure reasons for uncancelled high average failures)

R4.evidence: src/routes/index.tsx Tab 4 (Office Pre-Publication Checking List categorized by optional rule affected <= 2.0, practical part fail < 8, and absent marks AB per R-29)

team_members.major_contribution: Designed and implemented the GPA Engine, interactive calculation trace viewer, office checking list, and TanStack Start UI

major_design_decisions: Clean separation of GPA engine domain logic in src/lib/gpaEngine.ts for 100% testability and compliance with board rules
Comprehensive trace data structure that captures mark breakdown, reason codes, and step-by-step arithmetic resolution
Interactive filtering and sorting across all classes, letter grades, and office verification categories

ai_tools_used.used_for: Code generation, architecture, rule verification against public test fixture, and UI design
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Verified against all 25 test cases in P08_school_results_public.json and validated rule by rule (R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-29).
